Definition: from G3319; to form the middle, i.e. (in point of time), to be half-way over:--be about the midst.
BiblicalUsage: Mesoo means to be half-way over, about the midst, and John 7:14 uses it of the feast: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jesus came at the middle of the feast because He is the middle of it: the teaching the feast was pointing to all along.
